text: A few more facts. Methoxymethane and methoxyethane are gases. The others are colourless, sweet smelling liquids. They are very volatile and very inflammable, and the heavy vapour creeps along the bench to the nearest flame. And ether is lighter than water, with a density of zero point seven one three.
